name: Environment Indicator Header
description: displays the environment indicator version in a header.
project_description:
This module add a missing feature to Environment indicator module.

 Thanks to Environment Indicator Header, you can display the current release in the http header.

 Depends of Environment indicator module.

 How to install and configure ? 
 Install the Environment Indicator Header module as you would normally install a

contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further

information.
